text: {"findings":[{"type":"WEAK_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN","title":"Driver-level randomization leaks across shared supply pool","detail":"The test is randomized by driver for a dispatch assignment change. Drivers and orders share one supply pool, so effects leak between arms. Standards require switchback, geo, or market-level designs for routing and dispatch.","evidence_quote":"A/B test randomized by driver.","citations":["experimentation-standards#marketplace-interference"],"recommendation":"Use a switchback, geo, market, or zone-level design, and track adjacent zones for interference."},{"type":"WEAK_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN","title":"Test duration under 14 days","detail":"The plan runs for only 5 days, below the 14-day minimum needed to cover two full weekly cycles. No Data Science sign-off is recorded. The success metric also targets a 6-week window that the test does not cover.","evidence_quote":"Run for 5 days.","citations":["experimentation-standards#duration-and-seasonality"],"recommendation":"Run for at least 14 days, or obtain and record Data Science sign-off for a shorter test."},{"type":"WEAK_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN","title":"No MDE, power, or sample size pre-registered","detail":"The plan does not state a minimum detectable effect, sample size or power, or a stopping rule, all of which pre-registration requires before launch.","evidence_quote":"","citations":["experimentation-standards#pre-registration"],"recommendation":"Pre-register the primary metric, MDE (for example the +2 pt OTD target), power and sample size, and the stopping rule before launch."},{"type":"UNSUPPORTED_CLAIM","title":"Baseline stated without a verifiable source","detail":"The 87% On-Time Delivery Rate baseline is given as fact with no source or time period, unlike the problem statement, which cites an audit.","evidence_quote":"baseline 87%","citations":[],"recommendation":"Cite the data source and measurement period for the 87% baseline."}]}
